scope: The 64 non-Solar-Cycle readers present at the audit baseline.
method: Full-corpus lexical and named-reference inventories, existing-note comparison, targeted contextual reading, and independently opened external sources. This is not a new line-by-line close reading or a guarantee that every subtle allusion has been identified.
policy: External facts and contextual senses only. Preserve original prose, addresses, word counts, footnotes, translator notes, and optional afterwords. No quota-driven additions; uncertain connections begin Possibly in both definitions.
